evidence.quote: if (this.stock.get(size) === 0) throw new DomainError(400, `no hire skates of size ${size}`);

responsibilities.description: Checks that a booking request is valid: skater name, email, ticket count, phone, and hire skate quantities. It also rejects requests for missing, held or cancelled sessions.
responsibilities.name: Validate booking requests

responsibilities.description: Makes sure a booking does not exceed the tickets or the hire skates of each size still available for the session.

evidence.quote: if (input.tickets > avail.ticketsLeft) throw new DomainError(409, "not enough tickets left");

responsibilities.name: Enforce ticket and skate-hire availability

responsibilities.description: Limits members to a fixed number of free skates per calendar month. Pending and paid bookings both count toward the limit.
responsibilities.name: Enforce the monthly free-skate allowance for members

responsibilities.description: Works out the amount due. Members pay nothing for tickets, everyone else pays per ticket, and each hired pair of skates adds a fixed hire charge.
responsibilities.name: Calculate booking price

responsibilities.description: Creates the booking record, which is paid straight away when free and pending otherwise. It then starts a PuckPay checkout and marks the booking as failed if the checkout cannot be created.
responsibilities.name: Orchestrate booking creation and payment checkout

responsibilities.description: Updates a booking's status when a payment result arrives. A result can only settle a booking that is still pending. Refunds are recorded on paid or cancelled bookings. Applying the same result twice changes nothing, and late payments do not revive released bookings.
responsibilities.name: Apply payment results to bookings

responsibilities.description: Marks pending bookings as expired once their payment window has passed, which frees up their reserved capacity.
responsibilities.name: Expire unpaid bookings

responsibilities.description: Looks up a booking by its id, first releasing any expired bookings.
responsibilities.name: Retrieve a booking
